value.rationale: The source explicitly elevates the exact higher-order one-versus-three TISGM count to Conjecture 1 and leaves only numerical evidence for orders 4 through 15. Proving the conjectured phase boundary for every higher order closes a central gap in its static phase diagram. The result is structurally meaningful: it proves uniqueness of the entire symmetry-broken branch pair and removes an unresolved global minimization, rather than merely sharpening a numerical constant or treating an arbitrary parameter slice.
